metadata.case_name: HUI WING HUNG v. WONG WING KEE PLASTER ENGINEEERING CO LTD AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: right proximal forearm was badly hurt with blood bleeding profusedly from a wound of 1 cm long.
source: His right proximal forearm was badly hurt with blood bleeding profusedly from a wound of 1 cm long.
it is common ground that there is no fracture and there is partial tear of the exterior muscle.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration of other extensor muscle, fascia or tendon at forearm level

manifestations.description: blood bleeding profusedly from a wound of 1 cm long
weakness in his right forearm/right hand (reduced grip strength, weakness on exertion)
numbness (e.g. hand is numb after writing for about 3 minutes / increased numbness after writing more than 30 Chinese characters)
slight reduction in muscle bulk in his right forearm as compared to his left forearm

losses.description: Pain (residual pain lasting until mid 2008) - assessed at HK$40,000
Suffering (anxiety, frustration, sleeplessness, irritability) - assessed at HK$50,000

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Stopped hobbies such as basketball, gym, push-ups and driving motorcycle - assessed at HK$25,000

comparable_cases.case_name: Ngai Lung Hing v Gowin Engineering Co. Ltd and another
comparable_cases.injury_description: Right (dominant) forearm cut deeply by a sawing plate; 70% cut of brachioradialis muscle bulk and other muscles; emergency operation; pain and numbness; unable to perform previous duties.

comparable_cases.case_name: Ching Kam v Au Wing Keung & Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: Deep transverse cut to right forearm with muscles and tendons cut through; operation to sew severed tendons; stiffness, weakness and numbness of thumb; inability to grip; 25% loss of earning capacity.

comparable_cases.case_name: Lau Chi Man v Kowloon Canton Railway Corp.
comparable_cases.injury_description: Fractured shaft of right radius with open reduction and internal fixation, long scar, implant removal later, rehabilitation, stiffness and weakened right hand grip.
